fact: EMPA administration significantly reduced systolic blood pressure (SBP) by 4.93 mmHg (95% CI=[-9.67, -0.19]; P < 0.0001) in HF patients.
fact_zh: EMPA的使用显著降低了心力衰竭（HF）患者的收缩压（SBP）4.93 mmHg（95% CI=[-9.67, -0.19]；P < 0.0001）。
quote: EMPA administration significantly contributed to a reduction in systolic blood pressure (SBP) (MD = 4.93 mmHg, 95% CI=[-9.67, -0.19]; P < 0.0001)

fact: EMPA significantly reduced left ventricular end-diastolic volume (LVEDV) by 18.03 mL (95% CI=[-25.4, -10.67]; P < 0.0001) in HF patients.
fact_zh: EMPA显著降低了心力衰竭（HF）患者的左心室舒张末期容积（LVEDV）18.03 mL（95% CI=[-25.4, -10.67]；P < 0.0001）。
quote: left ventricular end-diastolic volume (LVEDV) (MD=-18.03 mL, 95% CI=[-25.4, -10.67], P < 0.0001)

fact: EMPA significantly reduced left ventricular end-systolic volume (LVESV) by 16.09 mL (95% CI=[-26.94, -5.25]; P < 0.0001) in HF patients.
fact_zh: EMPA显著降低了心力衰竭（HF）患者的左心室收缩末期容积（LVESV）16.09 mL（95% CI=[-26.94, -5.25]；P < 0.0001）。
quote: left ventricular end-systolic volume (LVESV) (MD=-16.09 mL, 95% CI=[-26.94, -5.25]; P < 0.0001)

fact: EMPA significantly decreased N-terminal pro-B-type NP (NT-proBNP) levels by SMD=-0.54 (95% CI=[-0.94, -0.13]; P = 0.01) in HF patients.
fact_zh: EMPA显著降低了心力衰竭（HF）患者的N末端B型利钠肽前体（NT-proBNP）水平，SMD=-0.54（95% CI=[-0.94, -0.13]；P = 0.01）。

fact: EMPA improved the 6-minute walk distance (6MWD) by SMD = 0.78 (95% CI=[-0.22, -1.79], P = 0.13) in HF patients.
fact_zh: EMPA改善了心力衰竭（HF）患者的6分钟步行距离（6MWD），SMD = 0.78（95% CI=[-0.22, -1.79]；P = 0.13）。
quote: improvements in the 6-minute walk distance (6MWD, SMD = 0.78, 95% CI=[-0.22, -1.79], P = 0.13)

fact: EMPA significantly improved the KCCQ score by MD = 1.98 (95% CI=[0.97–2.99]; P < 0.0001) in HF patients.
fact_zh: EMPA显著改善了心力衰竭（HF）患者的KCCQ评分，MD = 1.98（95% CI=[0.97–2.99]；P < 0.0001）。

fact: EMPA was associated with more pronounced benefits in HFrEF patients, including greater improvements in cardiac remodeling, function, and exercise capacity.
fact_zh: EMPA与HFrEF患者更显著的益处相关，包括心脏重塑、功能和运动能力的更大改善。
quote: more pronounced benefits in terms of cardiac remodeling, function and exercise capacity for specific populations, including (1) HF with a reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF)

fact: EMPA was associated with more pronounced benefits in patients without diabetes, including greater improvements in cardiac remodeling, function, and exercise capacity.
fact_zh: EMPA与无糖尿病患者更显著的益处相关，包括心脏重塑、功能和运动能力的更大改善。
quote: more pronounced benefits in terms of cardiac remodeling, function and exercise capacity for specific populations, including (2) the absence of diabetes

fact: EMPA was associated with more pronounced benefits in patients treated for no less than 6 months, including greater improvements in cardiac remodeling, function, and exercise capacity.
fact_zh: EMPA与治疗不少于6个月的患者更显著的益处相关，包括心脏重塑、功能和运动能力的更大改善。
quote: more pronounced benefits in terms of cardiac remodeling, function and exercise capacity for specific populations, including (3) treatment for no less than 6 months

fact: EMPA may lead to an increased risk of cardiovascular adverse events (AEs) in HF patients.
fact_zh: EMPA可能导致心力衰竭（HF）患者心血管不良事件（AEs）风险增加。
quote: EMPA may lead to an increased risk of cardiovascular adverse events (AEs)

fact: EMPA is less effective for improving the quality of life (QoL) in HFpEF populations.
fact_zh: EMPA在HFpEF人群中改善生活质量（QoL）的效果较差。
quote: is less effective for improving the QoL in HF patients with preserved EF (HFpEF) populations

fact: EMPA administration was associated with a statistically significant reduction in SBP from baseline by 1.19 mmHg (MD=-1.19 mmHg, 95% CI=[-8.56, -0.66], P = 0.001).
fact_zh: EMPA的使用与基线收缩压（SBP）显著降低1.19 mmHg相关（MD=-1.19 mmHg，95% CI=[-8.56, -0.66]，P = 0.001）。
quote: EMPA administration was associated with a statistically significant reduction in SBP from baseline by 1.19 mmHg (MD=-1.19 mmHg, 95% CI=[-8.56, -0.66], P = 0.001)

fact: EMPA significantly reduced the changes in LVEDV from baseline by 18.05 mL (MD=-18.05 mL, 95% CI=[-25.3, -10.80]; P < 0.0001).
fact_zh: EMPA显著降低了基线LVEDV的变化，减少了18.05 mL（MD=-18.05 mL，95% CI=[-25.3, -10.80]；P < 0.0001）。
sec: Results / Evaluation of left ventricular remodeling
quote: EMPA significantly reduced the changes in left ventricular end-diastolic volume (LVEDV) and left ventricular end-systolic volume (LVESV) from baseline by 18.05 mL (MD=-18.05 mL, 95% CI=[-25.3, -10.80]; P < 0.0001)
